Proposition
[Variation of a trace] 1. ch2:3.6 Source: topping:page-0031 \group topping-background

For $\alpha \in \Gamma (\otimes ^2T^*\M )$ depending on $t$, \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}(\tr \alpha ) =-\langle h,\alpha \rangle +\tr \frac{\partial \alpha }{\partial t}. \]
